name: cogitate-unified-engine
description: Unified dev runner for Schema Rater, Excel Rater, and Proxy Gateway

scripts.dev: concurrently --names PROXY,FRONTEND,SCHEMA-BE,EXCEL-BE -c cyan,magenta,green,yellow "npm run dev:proxy" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:schema-backend" "npm run dev:excel-backend"
scripts.install:frontends: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix schema-rater/frontend install && npm --prefix "excel-rater/cogitate rater/web-next" install
